changeSet.author: TKlok
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Tag') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Tag]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_Tag_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [Value] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [TagTypeId] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Tag_createdOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Tag_createdBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Tag_updatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Tag_updatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_Tag_State] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Tag] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END

changeSet.author: Tklok
changeSet.comment: By adding the TagTypeID column with a constraint to set the default value, we can impose NOT NULL from the start. The constraint is immediately dropped as we don't want it for regular use.
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[Tag]') AND name = 'TagTypeID') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Tag] ADD [TagTypeId] INT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT tag_tagtypeid_default DEFAULT 1
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Tag] DROP CONSTRAINT tag_tagtypeid_default
END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[dbo].[Tag]') AND name = 'TagTypeID') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Tag] drop column [TagTypeId] END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Tag_Uid_State_Value') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_Tag_Uid_State_Value ON [dbo].[Tag] ([uid], [State], [Value]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Tag_State_Value') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_Tag_State_Value ON [dbo].[Tag] ([State], [Value]) END
IF NOT EXISTS ( select 1 from [sys].[fulltext_indexes] i inner join [sys].[objects] o on o.object_id = i.object_id and o.Name = 'Tag' ) BEGIN CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX ON dbo.Tag(Value) KEY INDEX PK_Tag ON fullTextCatalog END
